sections.heading: Routing
paragraphs: App and email complaints receive a ticket number and a 24-hour acknowledgement. The DPO is the named escalation owner for unresolved complaints.

sections.heading: Measures
paragraphs: The DPO-operated grievance queue reports 38 cases closed in January-March 2026 with a median four-day resolution. The queue was established on 2026-04-01, when the current DPO took office.
From April to September the queue closed 82 cases; sample evidence and response letters were filed monthly.
